=Is the OAC CWC/RES campaign conversion good for me?=

Simply put. If you expect perfect quality, skip OAC and wait for CWR.<br>
If you are fine with minor issues (like non perfect camera scenes),<br>
or even want to help improving the available content, OAC is for you.<br>

OAC is fully compatible to CWR, can be combined with the latest release of CWR (the CWR demo).<br>
Once CWR 1.0 and their CWC campaign is out, you can bet you will enjoy the campaign with CWR once again.


=Why do you release now the CWC/RES campaign conversion?=

We felt happy with the result and it is done in agreement with CWR project leader W0lle.


=Why are both CWR and OAC working on a CWC/RES campaign conversion?=

Basically CWR does convert the OFP elite version of the CWC/RES campaign,<br>
while OAC uses the PC addition as the base.

We like the PC voices, that are different to the OFP elite ones which had to<br>
be rerecorded for the game.


=Why am I not able to install the OAC CWC/RES campaign conversion?=

Marek made it a required to OAC to have a registry check for the presence of<br>
a OFP/RES key entry.<br>
You have to install OFP/RES again to be able to install it.


=Why does the OAC CWC/RES campaign conversion not include the voice files?=

Codemasters did not give OAC (or anyone else) the permission to distribute<br>
the voices files. We accept this decision.

That said, you can easily unpack the OFP version of the CWC/RES campaign,<br>
delete all but the .ogg, .wss and .wav files and copy the voices files into<br>
the OAC CWC/RES campaign conversion.

 .\arma\campaigns\1985\

 .\arma\campaigns\resistance\

Here is a step-by-step guide.

# Goto the ''.\OFP\campaigns'' / ''.\OFP\res\campaigns'' folder.
# Unpack the 1985.pbo / Resistance.pbo with any of the [[OFP:_Community_Tools#PBO_Editing|OFP PBO tools]] (WinPBO or Eliteness recommended).
# Open the unpacked 1985/resistance folder.
# Use windows search (F3 -> enter) to find all files.
# Sort by type and delete all files but ogg, wav and wss.
# Copy the 1985/resistance folder inside the .\ArmA\campaigns folder.
# OK to overwrite all.
# Done. Enjoy the excellent atmosphere.

=Can I uninstall the OAC CWC/RES campaign?=

No the current installer does not have this feature.<br>
Yet the installer does '''NOT''' create registry or start menu entries so far.<br>
You can simply remove it by deleting the given campaign and the #OAC folder:

 .\arma\#oac
 .\arma\campaigns\1985 
 .\arma\campaigns\resistance

=Can I use the replacement configs even without OAC?=

The replacement configs are also useful without playing OFP missions/campaigns.<br>
Most replacement configs can be used without modification for 'standard' ArmA.<br>

You are recommended to load the '''ofp_compatibility_addon.pbo''' addon <br>
along with the replacement addons, even if you are not playing OFP missions.<br>
The addon is found in ''.\arma\x\oac\oac_core\addons''.

The alternative is to edit the replacement config yourself and remove the<br>
dependency to the ofp_compatibility_addon cfgPatches class and define the<br>
correct cfgPatches dependency yourself.<br>
An easy approach is to define a dependency to ''CA_Hotfix'' instead of the<br>
''ofp_compatibility_addon'' cfgPatches class.

= How do I update the OAC CWC/RES campaign =

You have to download and install the latest version again and again.<br>
You will find the campaigns in the {{Link|link= http://dev-heaven.net/projects/list_files/oac|OAC|text= files section}} for download


=I am dying all the time - what should I do?=

The missions are quite hard at times. Play more causiously.

You can always skip a mission with the [[ArmA: Armed Assault: Cheats |'endmission'|cheat]].
 

=Can I load my favorite addon with OAC?=

You can use '''any sort of ArmA addon''' along with OAC.<br>
Like addons to improve the standard game by model, texture, sound replacement, AI mods etc etc.
